_note: SINGLE source of truth for what a library icon (assets/icons/sgs-icons.json) may contain. Read by scripts/generate-icons.js (validates the raw library, refuses on any hit) AND scripts/promote-icon.py (normalises a proposal, refuses on any hit). Edit it here only; a cross-check test (tests/php/IconLibrarySecurityTest.php) fails if the two disagree on a hostile corpus. Distinct from includes/helpers-svg-kses.php (the wp_kses tag list, which DOES allow <use>/<image> href for logos): this list is the narrower pictogram allowlist, and it is the real security gate because the trust-bar slug branch echoes the generated PHP map.

refuseInRawLibrary._note: The generator sees the raw library and never rewrites it, so it refuses what promote-icon.py would drop or decode while normalising.
